Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of CRM.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $3.29 per share.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2021.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $3.29 per share.
Revenue guidance of $47.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 114 basis points to 44.7%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 4% to 9% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
